about: ESTIMATED, ILLUSTRATIVE elevation levels for the campus map. Which area is higher comes from the owner's annotated screenshot (2026-10-20): the north raised (middle), the south the highest. Where each slope starts and ends was then estimated (2026-10-20) from the owner's drone video (TikTok @ikraMRahim, used with permission; the frames named on each level) and from the climbing staircases in the app's STAIRS list. The heights are display values chosen to show the order (base < south terrace < middle < highest), not measurements. Each level rises gradually over slopeWidth_m metres outside its outline to a flat top; where two levels meet, the higher one wins. Replace with surveyed elevations when available.

properties.name: Middle Elevation
properties.source: estimated: the owner's annotation (which area is higher) with where the slopes start and end estimated from the drone video and the staircase list; illustrative
properties.evidence: Owner annotation: the north is raised (middle). Drone video: the covered walkways from the academic block to the northern blocks climb in steps (frames 11, 22) and roads rise toward the hostels (frames 21-24). The STAIRS list puts climbing stairs between about 5.3518 and 5.3525 N (ST14, ST18, ST19, ST20, ST21, ST26: 'naik ke' = going up), so the slope is drawn there, from the road north of the academic block up to the northern buildings.

properties.name: South terrace
properties.source: estimated: the owner's annotation (which area is higher) with where the slopes start and end estimated from the drone video and the staircase list; illustrative
properties.evidence: Drone video: a covered walkway with steps climbs a grass bank from the cafe and courts to the long block (frames 31-32), and grass banks with steps sit in front of the hostel blocks (frame 30). The STAIRS list: ST04 cafe to the tennis court, ST11 tennis court to Blok C, ST12 Blok C to Blok A/B. Drawn as a terrace at Blok C, half way up.

properties.name: Highest Elevation
properties.source: estimated: the owner's annotation (which area is higher) with where the slopes start and end estimated from the drone video and the staircase list; illustrative
properties.evidence: Owner annotation: the south is the highest area. Drone video: the hostel blocks A and B stand above a grass embankment with steps (frames 26-30). The STAIRS list: ST12 Blok C up to Blok A/B. Drawn as the top level, reached by a short steep bank south of the terrace.
